# Security Policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are applied to the current `main` branch and the production release derived from it. Historical commits and local development branches are not independently supported.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Do not open a public issue or pull request for a suspected vulnerability. Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/NVMtheName/Arbion-Platform/security/advisories/new). Include the affected component, reproduction steps, impact, and any safe supporting evidence. Do not include production credentials, customer financial data, MFA material, or destructive proof-of-concept actions.

If private reporting is unavailable, contact Arbion through the security contact published on `https://www.arbion.ai` and state only that you need a private security channel. Never send a secret in the initial message.

## Response

Arbion will acknowledge a valid private report, triage severity, preserve evidence, coordinate remediation and disclosure, and credit the reporter if requested and appropriate. Response timing depends on impact and reproducibility; this policy does not create a bug-bounty or payment commitment.

Testing must use accounts and data you own, avoid privacy violations or service disruption, and never place or attempt a live financial order. Social engineering, denial of service, credential attacks, and access to another user's data are prohibited.
